description:
A Pinterest profile plus its recent pins (up to 50) with images/videos, titles, descriptions, links and engagement counts.
Cost: 2 credits per successful call (failed calls are refunded).
Returns: user_id (string, nullable), username (string), full_name (string), about (string), website_url (string, nullable), domain (string, nullable), is_verified (boolean), follower_count (integer, nullable), following_count (integer, nullable), pin_count (integer, nullable), board_count (integer, nullable), video_pin_count (integer, nullable), profile_image_url (string, nullable), pins (array<object>), pins_fetched (integer), has_more (boolean).

limit.description: Maximum number of pins to return. Example: 12

username.description: Pinterest username, @handle or profile URL. Example: "nasa"

name: pinterest_pins
title: Pinterest pins
